title: abies cephalonica var. reginae-amaliae
intro: Abies cephalonica var. reginae-amaliae, commonly known as Greek fir, is a variant of the Abies cephalonica species, which is a coniferous evergreen tree native to Greece. The plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems due to its expectorant properties, and has been found to possess anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The health benefits of Abies cephalonica var. reginae-amaliae include relieving coughs, reducing fever, and soothing sore throats. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include terpenoids, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, and it is used in herbal remedies and aromatherapy to promote relaxation and reduce stress.
